data.name: GSH1_001
data.value: Why yes {0}...[pause=0] I'd love another Candied Oran...

data.name: GSH1_002
data.value: Goodness![pause=0] Are you alright?

data.name: GSH1_003
data.value: Oh no,[pause=10] d-did I h-hurt you?

data.name: GSH1_004
data.value: I'm s-so sorry![pause=0] I d-didn't m-mean to!

data.name: GSH1_005
data.value: It was an a-accident...[pause=0] I'm sorry...

data.name: GSH1_006
data.value: Are you o-okay?[pause=0] I'm sorry,[pause=10] I didn't mean to b-barge into you like that...

data.name: GSH1_007
data.value: Oh thank goodness.[pause=0] I'm glad you're not hurt.

data.name: GSH1_008
data.value: I hate even the idea of hurting others....

data.name: GSH1_009
data.value: If I had h-hurt you...[pause=0] I'd...[pause=0] I'd...

data.name: GSH1_010
data.value: But you're okay![pause=10] Hooray!

data.name: GSH1_011
data.value: What had you in such a hurry anyway?

data.name: GSH1_012
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] I'm just taking care of the chores around the guild.

data.name: GSH1_013
data.value: I have so much to do tonight that I have to run to get them all done before bedtime.

data.name: GSH1_014
data.value: Hey...[pause=0] I just realized I've never seen either of you before...[pause=0] Who are you guys?

data.name: GSH1_015
data.value: Right,[pause=10] we haven't introduced ourselves.

data.name: GSH1_016
data.value: I'm {0},[pause=10] my partner you bumped into is {1}.[pause=0] We're a new adventuring team!

data.name: GSH1_017
data.value: We just joined the guild a little while ago.

data.name: GSH1_018
data.value: New guild members?[pause=0] That's more work to add to my chore list...

data.name: GSH1_019
data.value: B-but don't worry about that![pause=0] It's no t-trouble at all!

data.name: GSH1_020
data.value: It's not that m-much more work![pause=0] It's part of my job,[pause=10] so it's no problem!

data.name: GSH1_021
data.value: I'm {0}![pause=0] I'm an apprentice here at the guild too!

data.name: GSH1_022
data.value: Glad to meet you,[pause=10] {0}!

data.name: GSH1_023
data.value: What were you up to in that room behind you anyway?

data.name: GSH1_024
data.value: That's the Guildmaster's quarters.[pause=0] I was tidying up in there for him.

data.name: GSH1_025
data.value: The Guildmaster's quarters,[pause=10] huh?[pause=0] I figured that the room we spoke to him in was his quarters.

data.name: GSH1_026
data.value: You must have been in his office.[pause=0] His actual bedroom is right down this hall.[pause=0] But...

data.name: GSH1_027
data.value: The Guildmaster doesn't like anyone going into his room.[pause=0] He only allows me to so I can take care of the chores.

data.name: GSH1_028
data.value: S-so please don't go in his room.[pause=0] I don't w-want to see you guys getting in trouble.

data.name: GSH1_029
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] alright.[pause=0] We'll stay away from that room then.

data.name: GSH1_030
data.value: Thank you![pause=0] I'm glad I caught you before you wandered in there by accident.

data.name: GSH1_031
data.value: I-If you ever need help with anything,[pause=10] let me know,[pause=10] OK?

data.name: GSH1_032
data.value: I promise I won't r-ram into you again like earlier![pause=0]\nS-Sorry again!

data.name: GSH1_033
data.value: I have to get back to my chores before it gets any later.[pause=0] Stay safe!

data.name: GSH1_034
data.value: Well,[pause=10] that was something.[pause=0] I wonder how often she bumps into others like that...

data.name: GSH1_035
data.value: She seemed nice enough though.

data.name: GSH1_036
data.value: I bet there's really cool trinkets and treasures in the Guildmaster's room.

data.name: GSH1_037
data.value: Surely a world class adventurer would have found a lot of cool stuff!

data.name: GSH1_038
data.value: We can't go in there though...[pause=0] I'd like to see some of his treasure some day though.

data.name: GSH1_039
data.value: Hey {0}...[pause=0] It's getting pretty late...

data.name: GSH1_040
data.value: We should head back to our room and hit the hay for the night.

data.name: GSH1_041
data.value: Let's head there whenever you're ready,[pause=10] {0}.
